# Binder Grail

> Binder Grail (bindergrail.com) is the home for budget-conscious Pokémon TCG
> collectors: practical market analysis, honest buying advice, free collecting
> tools, and a weekly newsletter. No hype, no financial advice cosplay. Just
> the thinking a knowledgeable collector friend would text you.

## Tools

- [Pocket Money](https://pocketmoney.bindergrail.com): Free hobby budgeting
  app, live now. Monthly budget envelope, wallet stashes for category spending
  (envelope budgeting for sneakers, TCG, anything), pending holds for
  preorders, spend/return/sale logging with tags, a wishlist with reserved
  funds, and a grail fund with progress tracking. No bank linking, ever.
  Landing page: https://bindergrail.com/pocket-money
- Origins: Pokémon TCG collection tracker (log condition, price paid, and see
  collection value). Pre-launch, waitlist at https://bindergrail.com/origins

## Newsletter

- [Common Rare](https://commonrare.bindergrail.com): free weekly Pokémon TCG
  newsletter. Market moves, restock alerts, and a plain verdict on every new
  product. Issue archive at https://bindergrail.com/newsletter

## Evergreen guides

- [How to Build a Pokémon Collection on a Budget](https://bindergrail.com/blog/how-to-build-a-pokemon-collection-on-a-budget):
  The flagship guide: set a monthly limit, split sealed vs singles, and grow a
  collection without blowing up your finances.
- [How to Collect Pokémon Cards in 2026](https://bindergrail.com/blog/how-to-collect-pokemon-cards-in-2026):
  What to buy, what to avoid, and how to think about sealed, singles, and PSA
  grading in the Mega Evolution era.
- [Best Sealed Pokémon Products to Hold](https://bindergrail.com/blog/best-sealed-pokemon-products-to-hold):
  Which sealed products actually appreciate and which to leave on the shelf.
- [How to Evaluate a New Pokémon Set](https://bindergrail.com/blog/how-to-evaluate-a-new-pokemon-set):
  A repeatable framework for judging a new set before you spend a dollar.
- [How to Make Money with Pokémon Cards](https://bindergrail.com/blog/how-to-make-money-with-pokemon-cards):
  Realistic ways to profit: sealed holds, flipping, grading plays, and the
  math behind each.
- [Modern vs. Vintage Pokémon Investing](https://bindergrail.com/blog/modern-vs-vintage-pokemon-investing):
  Risk, liquidity, and print cycles compared across modern and vintage cards.
- [Understanding Pokémon Print Cycles](https://bindergrail.com/blog/understanding-pokemon-print-cycles):
  How reprints work, how they hit prices, and when to buy or sell modern sets.
- [How to Buy Pokémon Cards Like a Sneakerhead](https://bindergrail.com/blog/how-to-buy-pokemon-cards-like-a-sneakerhead):
  Sourcing mindset borrowed from sneaker culture: retail discipline, timing,
  and negotiating.
- [Three Things to Beat Pokémon TCG Scalpers](https://bindergrail.com/blog/three-things-to-beat-pokemon-tcg-scalpers):
  The concrete tools (restock alerts, store timing, preorder channels) that
  get you product at MSRP.
